overview.rankFilter: Emerald+ (OP.GG, patch 26.19; values are percentages). Lolalytics Emerald+ shows 51.37% WR / 5.83% PR / 9.93% BR; Skill Capped 49.8% / 6.0% / 10.6%.
overview.playstyle: You are a scaling duelist who trades with short W auto-resets and E dodges in lane, then turns into a split-pushing, 1v1-winning monster once Trinity Force and Sundered Sky are done. Look for all-ins on Counter Strike (E) against auto-attack reliant champions, respect ranged and kite-heavy lanes, and use your top role quest (level 20 cap, free Unleashed Teleport) to either pressure side lanes or join fights late.

seasonNotes: 26.1 (season start): Role Quests added. Your top quest needs 1200 points (7.5 pts/5s in lane, 1 pt/3s out of lane, starting 1:05; also 15 per takedown, 2 per minion) and completes passively around 13:35 at the latest.

Top quest reward: +600 XP, +11% XP from all sources, +80 XP per champion takedown, level cap raised to 20, and a free Unleashed Teleport (390 s cooldown since 26.19). If you already run Teleport, it instead gives a 35% max-health shield for 10 s after channeling and 30 s lower cooldown - this is why Flash + Ignite is Jax's most common setup.
26.1: Jax passive (Relentless Assault) gains an extra 1.5% attack speed per stack at level 19 - reaching level 19-20 via the quest is a real power spike for you.

26.1: Atakhan (plus Blood Roses) and Feats of Strength removed; First Blood and First Turret again give +100 and +300 bonus gold. Baron back to 20:00. Epic monsters level with champions and are ~15% tankier.

26.1: Minions spawn at 0:30 (was 1:05), jungle camps at 0:55 (was 1:30) - lane starts and first ganks come earlier. Per the /dev preview, turrets take 20% more melee damage and plates are also on inner/inhibitor turrets, which suits split-pushing Jax.

26.1: Demolish simplified (bonus damage on your third attack against a tower). New items include Dusk and Dawn (Sheen-based AP/on-hit item), Hextech Gunblade and Stormrazor returned; base crit damage 200%.

26.9 (Season 2): New starters Doran's Bow and Doran's Helm plus new boots Gluttonous Greaves; Opportunity and Trailblazer removed; Dusk and Dawn reworked (gained healing, reduced stats); top quest XP tuned to favor teamfighting over pure splitpushing.
26.12: Jax buffs - Q Leap Strike mana cost 65 -> 50; E Counter Strike damage 3.5% -> 4% (min) and 7% -> 8% (max) of target max health.
26.16 + 26.17: Sundered Sky nerfed twice (heal 100% base AD + 6% missing HP -> 90% + 4% for melee; health 450 -> 400; AD 45 -> 40). 26.16: Sterak's Gage bonus AD raised to 50% base AD (from 45%).
26.17: Jax 'bug fixes' in the patch notes (Q magic damage, R renamed) apply only to the League Classic mode, not normal Summoner's Rift.
26.19 (current): no Jax changes. Top quest Teleport 420 s -> 390 s; Unleashed Teleport cooldown reduced by 30 s. Worlds 2026 will be played on 26.20.

voidgrubs.notes: 3 Voidgrubs, spawn once per game (no respawn). Despawn at 14:45 (14:55 if in combat). Each grub gives your team a Touch of the Void stack (structure burn); 3 stacks add Hunger of the Void (allied Voidmites on turrets) - very strong for a splitpusher like you.

riftHerald.notes: Spawns once in the grub pit, despawns 19:45 (19:55 in combat). Eye of the Herald summons a pushing Herald - use it top to take plates/turret when your jungler can help.

elderDragon.spawn: After a team secures Dragon Soul (4th drake)

objectiveTimers.otherNotes: Atakhan no longer exists (removed 26.1). Minions spawn 0:30, jungle camps 0:55. Hand of Baron lasts 180 s. Your top quest finishes around 13:35 at the latest - plan Teleport plays around Herald (15:00) and drakes.

abilities.name: Relentless Assault
abilities.summary: Your basic attacks stack bonus attack speed (up to 8 stacks, 2.5 s, 5-12.5% per stack by level), with an extra 1.5% per stack at level 19.
tips: Pre-stack on minions before you trade, especially with Lethal Tempo, so you enter the fight at high attack speed.
Stacks fall off one at a time - keep auto-attacking something (minion, ward, champion) to keep them.
Level 19-20 (only reachable via the top quest) adds more attack speed per stack.

abilities.name: Leap Strike
abilities.summary: Dash (700 range) to any unit, ally, ward or enemy, dealing physical damage (65-225 +100% bonus AD) if the target is an enemy; you can cast other abilities mid-dash.
tips: Costs only 50 mana since 26.12, but it's still your only gap-closer and escape: save it to follow or disengage.
Ward-hop or jump to allied minions/champions to escape ganks.
Cast W before or during Q so the leap itself is empowered.
Cast E during the Q dash to land already dodging.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.summary: Your next basic attack or Leap Strike deals bonus magic damage (50-190 +60% AP), gains 50 range, and resets your auto-attack timer.
tips: Standard short trade: AA > W > AA so the reset gives two quick hits.
The extra 50 range lets you poke with W and back off, especially with Grasp.
You max W first - it is your main lane damage and triggers Sheen/Trinity Force Spellblade.

abilities.name: Counter Strike
abilities.summary: For up to 2 s you dodge non-turret basic attacks and take 25% less area damage; recast after 1 s (or let it end) to stun nearby enemies (375 radius) for 1 s and deal 4-8% of their max health plus base damage, doubling with dodged attacks.
tips: Vs auto-attackers (Fiora-type duelists, marksmen) activate E first and let them waste autos into it - max damage when they hit it.
Wait at least 1 s before recasting; recasting instantly wastes the dodge window.
Start E level 1 for early trades and to deny the enemy's level-1 autos.
Doesn't dodge turret shots or most abilities - don't dive expecting E to save you.

abilities.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
abilities.summary: Passive: every third basic attack deals bonus magic damage (75-185 +60% AP). Active: lantern slam deals magic damage in 375 radius and grants you bonus armor (45-75 +40% bonus AD) and 60% as much MR for 8 s (more per extra champion hit); while active the passive procs every second attack.
tips: Activate R when you're in the middle of multiple enemies - the resistances scale with champions hit.
Use R early in a duel, not as a panic button at low HP: the resistances and faster passive procs win extended trades.
Count your autos - the 3rd-hit passive plus W and Spellblade is your burst window.

combos.name: Short trade (auto reset)
combos.when: Lane poke when the enemy walks up for a last hit; lowest risk trade.

combos.name: Standard all-in
combos.input: E > Q > W > AA > AA > E recast (stun)
combos.when: Enemy is in Q range and you have the level/HP advantage; E first dodges their autos while you close the gap.

combos.name: Empowered leap poke
combos.input: W > Q (empowered leap) > E recast if needed > walk away
combos.when: Quick burst when you can leap onto the enemy and they can't punish (e.g. after they used a key spell).

combos.name: Surprise stun
combos.input: E > walk/Q in > Flash > E recast
combos.when: Chasing a low enemy or catching someone out of Q range - flash onto them with E already active to guarantee the stun.

combos.name: Teamfight dive
combos.input: E > Q onto priority target > R in the crowd > W > AA
combos.when: Late game: leap onto the backline, stun with E recast and pop R when you'll hit several champions for max resistances.

combos.name: Escape
combos.input: Q to ward/ally minion (optionally E to dodge autos)
combos.when: Getting ganked or chased; ward-hop over walls.

runes.name: Lethal Tempo (most played)
runes.when: Default into melee and most matchups; wins extended trades and scales into split-push duels. Coup de Grace is the other common 3rd-row pick; Legend: Haste is reported as a higher-win-rate alternative to Legend: Alacrity.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying (short trades / lane sustain)
runes.when: When you want to win lane with short W pokes rather than long trades (e.g. vs tanks or lanes where you can't stay in extended fights). Skill Capped page shown; OP.GG's most played Grasp variant is Demolish / Second Wind / Unflinching + Inspiration secondary (24.80% pick, 50.44% WR - highest win rate of the common pages).

runes.name: Lethal Tempo + Inspiration (scaling)
runes.when: Safer/scaling lanes where you don't need the Resolve defense; OP.GG rates the Precision + Inspiration Lethal Tempo pages at 8.42% pick / 52.09% WR (minor rune picks may vary; runes shown are Skill Capped's).

runes.name: Press the Attack (vs ranged)
runes.when: Skill Capped recommends it vs ranged tops like Quinn or Jayce where Lethal Tempo/Grasp underperform. Secondary tree not specified by the source - standard Resolve secondary shown.

summoners.when: Default (66.71% pick, 49.51% WR on OP.GG). The top quest already gives you a free Unleashed Teleport, so Ignite adds kill pressure in lane.
Vs lane bullies/ranged (e.g. Teemo, Quinn) where you'll lose HP and need to get back to lane (23.91% pick, 49.28% WR). After the quest your Teleport gets a 35% max-HP shield and -30 s cooldown.
Vs burst all-in champions like Riven (Skill Capped).

skillOrder.notes: Most common order on OP.GG: E Q W W W R W E W E R E E Q Q (55.02% pick, 54.46% WR). Start E level 1 for trades and to dodge level-1 autos; take W at 2 instead of Q if you want the AA > W reset trade early (Skill Capped: E > W > Q). R at 6/11/16. Q is maxed last.

startingItems.when: Tankier start vs mixed/poke damage (11.20% pick, 49.14% WR).
Aggressive attack-speed start in winnable melee lanes; small sample but high WR (5.87% pick, 51.58% WR on OP.GG; Lolalytics 53.15% WR with 2 potions).

firstItemOptions.when: Default first item almost every game (77.68% of builds on OP.GG). Rush Sheen first.
Vs high-HP tanks/bruisers or when you need lifesteal to duel.
AP/on-hit hybrid path (Skill Capped: when your team is AD-heavy); follow with Hextech Gunblade / Riftmaker.

boots.when: Vs heavy CC or AP damage (32.16% pick, 50.23% WR).
Low-threat lanes where you want ability haste (8.99% pick, 54.77% WR).
Snowballing/omnivamp option; rare (1.69% pick, 57.64% WR, small sample).

firstBackBuys.buy: Sheen - Spellblade after W/Q is your biggest early damage increase.
Phage (if you already have Sheen, or you need HP more than burst).

items.name: Trinity Force
items.why: Spellblade + attack speed + HP + movement; your standard first item.

items.name: Sundered Sky
items.why: Guaranteed crit + heal on your first auto vs each champion; standard 2nd item (nerfed in 26.16/26.17 but still core).

items.name: Sterak's Gage
items.why: Tenacity, HP and a big Lifeline shield; high-WR 4th/5th item (buffed in 26.16).

items.name: Death's Dance
items.why: Armor and delays burst damage; common 3rd-4th item.

items.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
items.why: Armor + AP (scales your W/E/R) and Stasis to dodge ults (e.g. Zed R, Fizz R); very high WR as 3rd/4th item.

items.name: Guardian Angel
items.why: Revive; common last item when you're the win condition.

items.name: Blade of The Ruined King
items.why: %HP on-hit damage and lifesteal to shred tanks and bruisers in duels.

items.name: Dusk and Dawn
items.why: AP/on-hit Sheen item that doubles on-hits; start of the hybrid/AP Jax path (best when your own team is AD-heavy).

items.name: Hextech Gunblade
items.why: Hybrid AD/AP with vamp and targeted active; used in the AP/hybrid build (common in jungle).

items.name: Riftmaker
items.why: AP/HP with omnivamp and ramping damage in long fights; very high WR as 4th/5th item on Lolalytics.

items.name: Black Cleaver
items.why: Armor shred and HP for fights against tanky frontlines.

items.name: Kaenic Rookern
items.why: Big magic shield vs AP burst in short fights.

items.name: Force of Nature
items.why: Sustained MR vs repeated magic damage.

items.name: Maw of Malmortius
items.why: AD + MR + magic shield when you need to survive AP assassins but keep damage.

items.name: Spirit Visage
items.why: MR and increased healing (pairs with Sundered Sky heals).

items.name: Randuin's Omen
items.why: Reduces crit damage vs marksmen/crit-heavy teams.

items.name: Thornmail
items.why: Grievous Wounds on auto-attackers who hit you.

items.name: Chempunk Chainsword
items.why: Offensive Grievous Wounds vs healers/drain tanks.

items.name: Wit's End
items.why: Attack speed + MR + on-hit magic damage for dueling AP bruisers.

items.name: Hullbreaker
items.why: Pure split-push item - only when you're side-laning alone.

items.name: Plated Steelcaps
items.why: Default boots; armor and reduced auto-attack damage.

items.name: Mercury's Treads
items.why: Tenacity + MR vs CC/AP teams.

items.name: Ionian Boots of Lucidity
items.why: Ability haste for more E/R uptime when you don't need resist boots.

powerSpikes.what: Counter Strike start: trade into auto-attack champions by pressing E before they hit you; don't fight ranged champs at level 1.
Full kit (E+Q+W): first real all-in window, especially with Ignite. Look to trade when the enemy used a key cooldown.
R adds armor/MR and faster passive procs - you win most extended trades vs melee; look for all-ins or dives with jungle.
Spellblade makes every W/Q trade much stronger; buy it on first back if you can.
Your first big item spike (~12 min): start split-pushing and taking duels.

powerSpikes.when: Top role quest done (~13:35 at the latest)
powerSpikes.what: +600 XP, level cap 20, free Unleashed Teleport (or shielded Teleport): use the TP for Herald (15:00) or dragon fights, or keep side lane pressure.
Two-item duelist spike: you out-duel most side laners; force 1v1s and pressure towers (melee deals 20% more damage to turrets this season).
Rank 3 R, then extra attack speed per passive stack at 19 - your late-game ceiling is higher than lanes without the quest.

jungle.runes: Precision primary with Inspiration secondary (Lolalytics jungle page); keystone varies - Press the Attack shows the highest win rate on a small sample (64.53%, 203 games). Summoners: Flash + Smite.
jungle.build: Mosstomper Seedling + Health Potion start; Dusk and Dawn > Mercury's Treads > Hextech Gunblade > Death's Dance (Lolalytics).
jungle.clear: Start E at level 1, W at 2, Q at 3; max W first, then Q, E last in the jungle (W 2/4/5/7/9, Q 3/8/10/12/13, E 1/14/15). Camps spawn at 0:55.
jungle.notes: 13.8% of Jax games are jungle (Lolalytics, Emerald+); jungle Jax 51.52% WR, 0.97% pick rate, B tier. Top is his main role (83.3%).
